caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden body that features a rich brown color and subtle yellowish inlays outlining geometric shapes on the panels of the lower section and door. The clock’s face is square, metallic, and silver in tone, with black Roman numerals, black clock hands, and an arc at the top with additional decoration, including gold and blue accents. The upper section of the clock, housing the face, includes intricate scrollwork and three gold finial ornaments on top. The entire piece stands upright on a plain background with no other objects or details, and there is a small printed text in the lower left corner that reads "ANTHONY JOHNSON."
title: Tall Clock
